description:
Search Interoperability message headers in a required time window. Use it to find messages by item, status, session, body class or error flag, by what their bodies hold (body action), or by an indexed Search Table value such as an HL7 medical record number (searchTable action), before reading, diagramming or resending them. Returns paged header rows only: id, sessionId, type, status, isError, sourceItem, targetItem, bodyClassName, bodyId, UTC times (timeCreated, timeProcessed, each with a ...Raw sibling) and correspondingMessageId. A row never carries message body content, error text or descriptions. Rows come oldest first; when hasMore is true, pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

Actions:
- **headers** (read, enabled by default): search the headers.
- **body** (read, enabled by default): search by body content. It requires bodyClass, the exact name of a persistent body class in the namespace (only headers of exactly that class match; a subclass is a different class), and filters: 1 to 10 conditions combined with AND, each {property, op, value}. property is the exact, case-sensitive name of one property of bodyClass (letters and digits; not an SQL column name, not a dotted path). op is eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, contains, startsWith, isNull or notNull. value is a string of 1 to 1024 characters, a number or a boolean; leave it out for isNull and notNull. eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge and startsWith compare by the property's collation, so a default string property ignores case; contains is a case-sensitive substring test; % and _ are ordinary characters; ne never matches an empty (null) value. Values are compared in IRIS logical form: a date property takes its day number and a time property its seconds since midnight, not a formatted string; a timestamp property takes its stored text, such as '2001-02-03 08:00:00', not an ISO 8601 'T' form; a number is sent in IRIS canonical form (0.5 becomes .5), so give a text property a string. A header whose body no longer exists never matches. On EnsLib.HL7.Message, RawContent holds only the first 10,000 characters of the message, so a search on it does not see later text. A stream property accepts only isNull and notNull. Properties without a column are refused: list and array collections, embedded (serial) objects, relationships, multidimensional properties, and transient or calculated properties that are not SQL-computed. Everything is validated on the IRIS side and every value is bound as a parameter. The result is the header rows of the matching messages, plus dataPolicy; it never contains a body value. The body action is under the PHI data policy (IRIS_DATA_POLICY, set per profile; default redact): under block it is refused with the DATA_POLICY_BLOCKED code and no IRIS call, so use headers or ask the operator for a looser policy; under redact and allow it runs. Which headers match still shows what the bodies hold, so an operator who does not accept that uses block or restricts the body key.
- **searchTable** (read, enabled by default): find messages by an indexed Search Table value, such as the HL7 messages of one medical record number. It requires searchTableClass, the exact name of a compiled virtual-document Search Table class in the namespace, such as EnsLib.HL7.SearchTable, and filters: 1 to 10 conditions combined with AND, each {property, op, value}, with the same operators and value rules as the body action. property is the exact, case-sensitive name of a property that class defines or inherits from its Search Table superclasses (not a column name). EnsLib.HL7.SearchTable has MSHTypeName (MSH-9 as ADT_A01), MSHControlID (MSH-10), PatientID (PID-2, every PID-3 repetition and PID-4: use it for a medical record number), PatientName (PID-5) and PatientAcct (PID-18). A message matches eq, lt, le, gt, ge, contains or startsWith when it has at least one non-empty entry for the property whose stored value satisfies it, so a multi-valued property such as PatientID matches on any of its values. ne matches when the message has no entry equal to the value (a message that was never indexed included), not when some entry differs. isNull matches when it has no non-empty entry (a message that was never indexed included) and notNull when it has at least one. Values are normalized as the Search Table stores them: a default property ignores case (give the value in any case); a String:CaseSensitive property such as MSHControlID compares exactly; an Integer, Numeric or Boolean property takes only eq, ne, isNull and notNull, with its value normalized (0007 is 7), because a range or substring of a stored number is meaningless; a | is stored as +; and the Search Table stores each value truncated to 256 characters, so a value longer than 256 characters is refused. Only headers of the Search Table's document class match (EnsLib.HL7.Message for EnsLib.HL7.SearchTable), because its entries are keyed by that class's IDs; bodyClass, when given, must be the exact name of a compiled class that is or extends it, and replaces it. Custom search tables (Ens.CustomSearchTable subclasses) are not supported. An unknown property is refused with an error that lists the class's configured property names. A namespace with no Search Table property returns notApplicable: true. A Search Table holds only the messages indexed when they were processed (or rebuilt with BuildIndex), so no match does not prove that no message holds the value. Everything is validated on the IRIS side and every value is bound as a parameter. The result is the header rows of the matching messages, plus dataPolicy; it never contains a Search Table value. The searchTable action is under the PHI data policy like body: under block it is refused with the DATA_POLICY_BLOCKED code and no IRIS call; under redact and allow it runs. Which headers match still shows what the bodies hold, so an operator who does not accept that uses block or restricts the searchTable key.

Scope: from is required (ISO 8601 with Z or an offset); to defaults to now; the window may span at most 7 days. There is no whole-namespace mode. When paging a window close to 7 days wide, pass the same from and to on every page, because an omitted to is recomputed as now on each call. limit (default 100, max 500) caps the rows returned per page, not the work done: a wide window on a busy namespace is scanned in full and can approach the ~60 s Web Gateway timeout, so narrow the window: a filter narrows the rows returned, not the window scanned. The body action reads the headers in the window first and each body by its ID, so a body filter does not reduce the work; the searchTable action also reads the headers in the window first and probes the Search Table by each header's body ID, so a Search Table filter does not reduce that work either.

Header filters match by equality, not by pattern (% and _ are ordinary characters), and the name filters ignore case: item (the source or the target), source, target, status (Created, Queued, Delivered, Discarded, Suspended, Deferred, Aborted, Errored, Completed; rows report Errored as Error), sessionId, bodyClass (on the headers action), and errorOnly (the IsError flag, which is separate from status Error). The filters parameter belongs to the body and searchTable actions only, and searchTableClass to the searchTable action only; the other actions refuse them.

A namespace without Interoperability returns notApplicable: true with a reason, not an error.

GOVERNANCE - all three actions are reads and enabled by default. An operator can restrict one with IRIS_GOVERNANCE, e.g. {"global": {"iris_message_search:headers": false}}; the other keys are iris_message_search:body and iris_message_search:searchTable.

action.description: Action: headers (search headers), body (search by body content; needs bodyClass and filters), searchTable (search by an indexed Search Table value; needs searchTableClass and filters).

bodyClass.description: Message body class name. On headers it filters by class name (ignoring case). On body it is REQUIRED: the exact name of a persistent class with an SQL table, such as Ens.StringRequest. On searchTable it is optional: the exact name of a compiled class that is or extends the Search Table's document class, which it replaces as the header class to match.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.

errorOnly.description: Only messages whose IsError flag is set (not the same as status Error).

filters.description: body and searchTable actions only (REQUIRED there; the headers action refuses it): 1 to 10 conditions on body properties (body) or Search Table properties (searchTable), combined with AND. Each is {property, op, value}.

property.description: The exact, case-sensitive name of one property of bodyClass (or of searchTableClass).

value.description: The value to compare with (required except for isNull and notNull).

from.description: Window start (REQUIRED): ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z.

item.description: Config item name; matches the source or the target.

limit.description: Rows per page (default 100, max 500). An output cap, not timeout protection.

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to operate on a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

searchTableClass.description: searchTable action only (REQUIRED there; the other actions refuse it): the exact name of a compiled virtual-document Search Table class in the namespace, such as EnsLib.HL7.SearchTable.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

status.description: Message status filter. Rows report Errored as Error.

to.description: Window end: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (default: now). At most 7 days after from.

name: iris_message_search
title: Search Interoperability Messages
